events.text: U-254 conducted her warm-up and training period in the Baltic Sea in the first half of 1942.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She conducted her warm-up and training period in the Baltic Sea in the first half of 1942

events.text: U-254 sank a small British freighter.
events.subject: self
events.quote: sinking a small British freighter on 2 August

events.text: The British ship was sunk by three torpedoes.
events.subject: self
events.quote: This was followed six days later by another success in a similar area , when the British ship was sunk by three torpedoes

events.text: U-254 departed after repairs in late November 1942.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After repairs , U-254 departed in late November 1942

events.text: U-254 was directed to Convoy HX 217 on 8 December.
events.subject: self
events.quote: to which she had been directed on 8 December

events.text: U-254 collided with another submarine and sank.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The two submarines had become lost in the dark and collided with one another in a freak accident

dropped.text: U-254 spotted and sank the 11,000 ton American tanker Esso Williamsburg with one torpedo.
dropped.subject: self
dropped.quote: on 3 October , after twelve days of cruising , she spotted the 11,000 ton American tanker Esso Williamsburg
